Subject: Trial sprint plan & success criteria — post-demo recap

Hi Oliver / Priya — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of ask
- Radiosense wants a 3-week trial to validate two main items: 1) extractive summarization for multi-source incident reports, and 2) a 1:1 reduction in time-to-triage for on-call engineers (target: 30% reduction).

Draft success criteria (attached):
- Summarization F1 > 0.78 on annotated sample set (see sheet: scoring).
- Triage reduction measured by average incident first-response time (compare baseline week to trial week).
- Maximum acceptable latency: 500ms 95th percentile for single-turn generation.

Proposed sprint plan (high level):
Week 0 — onboarding & infra prep (keys, sample data drop, SOC 2 evidence exchange)
Week 1 — model tuning + integration with their ingestion pipeline
Week 2 — validation runs & MLP (manual labeling panel)
Week 3 — consolidated readout and exec decision window

Owners (initial):
- Technical integration: Ben Carter
- Evaluation & metrics: Marissa Cole
- Customer success/ops: Stephanie Nguyen
- Sales/exec coordination: Mina Haddad

Attachments: radiosense_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success criteria + scoring plan), trial_schedule_v1.pdf (timeline + milestones)

Next actions (proposed):
1) Radiosense to confirm sample dataset delivery date (ideally Wed 6/9).
2) Redwood to provision trial workspace and share runbook by Mon 6/7.
3) Schedule a 30-min exec readout tentatively for week of 6/28 — Oliver/Priya please share preferred slots.

If that looks right I’ll update the schedule and share a lightweight mutual action plan.

– Mina Haddad
